name: Agora Invoicing WordPress Plugin
author: Ladybird Web Solution Pvt Ltd

sections.description:
The Agora Invoicing WordPress plugin enables you to integrate Agora Invoicing Software with your WordPress website. With this plugin, you can easily display product information, pricing, and other invoicing details directly on your site, improving the user experience and simplifying your invoicing process.

WordPress plugin website

Developed by Ladybird Web Solution Pvt Ltd, this plugin was launched in November 2024 to provide a seamless connection between Agora Invoicing and WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the agora-invoicing folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin by going to Settings -> Agora Invoicing.
sections.faq:
How do I set the API URL?

Go to Settings -> Agora Invoicing and enter the API URL.

short_description: This plugin pulls product pricing, Description/Details, currency, and order URL from the Faveo Agora invoicing web application.
